scope: a new auction created, sealed, funded, cleared and settled through the hosted live demo (https://49-12-250-128.sslip.io) on standard public Zcash testnet (NU7); every role on the one hosted server; testnet coins and synthetic demo bids only
driven_by: tools/demo-capture/capture.mjs with DARKCALL_URL=https://49-12-250-128.sslip.io/ (headless browser, the same clicks a visitor makes)

auction.terms: 3 units, reserve 20, budget 100 zatoshi, processing fee 15,000 zatoshi

chain.provider: https://testnet.zec.rocks:443 (trusted for chain data; the network validates every broadcast)

checks.winner_receipt: ticket 01 decrypted its own memo: won, refund 79
checks.loser_receipt: ticket 04 decrypted its own memo: lost, refund 100
checks.corrupted_receipt_proof: refused before the bidder's key was read
checks.public_bundle_verified_on_a_second_machi: make verify BUNDLE=hosted-testnet-auction-nu7-v1 on the author's Mac, 21 s, no private material

same_server_also.hosted_http_checks: scripts/check_hosted_http.py through an SSH tunnel: 9 of 9 in 8.4 s (pages, other host refused, hosted state, origin and token required, bidder receipt, proof trail, refused cheat, per-address limit)
same_server_also.unfunded_live_auction: reserve 10, outside the native settlement terms: four bids sealed, certified and cleared by REP3 and coNoir in 7.1 s, own result opened (tools/demo-capture/record.mjs live)

fixed_before_this_run.symptom: the bank rescan from its Oct 19 birthday spanned 31,000 blocks, past the 100 MB capture read bound (public testnet now runs near 10 KB a block) and the 20,000-block window
fixed_before_this_run.fix: an old bank deposits from its latest scan; each funding moves its birthday to the block before the deposit

fixed_before_this_run.symptom: extracted bank and run directories were 0755; the wallet tool requires 0700
fixed_before_this_run.fix: the hosted pack carries 0700 directory entries

fixed_before_this_run.symptom: a deposit built from the Oct 21 scan took its expiry from that scan and the network refused it as expired
fixed_before_this_run.fix: an optional target height; the testnet driver passes the current tip

fixed_before_this_run.symptom: the network refused the next deposit as a double spend: the Oct 21 one-unit deposit had spent the scanned note
fixed_before_this_run.fix: testnet-capture can stop at a chosen block, and `testnet_chain.py rebase-bank` starts the bank at that deposit

fixed_before_this_run.symptom: every MPC gate ran its parties under BSD `/usr/bin/time -l`; the Linux image has GNU time or none, so no new auction could clear
fixed_before_this_run.fix: GNU time -v on Linux, the time package in the image

after_this_run.prover_memory_ceiling: the six funded rows peaked at 7.91 GiB against the 8 GiB resident guard; DARKCALL_MAX_PROVER_GIB now sets it, 12 on the hosted server, 8 by default

stranded_testnet_deposit.zatoshi: 4 x 15,100 in the 2-of-3 escrow, plus the 25,000 fee
stranded_testnet_deposit.cause: funded before the GNU time fix, then clearing stopped; the demo refuses to clear a book whose clearing failed
stranded_testnet_deposit.status: escrow keys, journals and the funding record kept on the server outside the served data; no refund attempted (the refund path is demonstrated on regtest only and disabled for testnet on the hosted API)

limits: all three operators, the bidders' clients and the bank run on one server; the hosted client sees each typed demo bid
testnet chain data comes from one trusted lightwalletd provider
REP3 is semi-honest; two colluding operators could rebuild the bids
